item.title: COLUMN: EIU’s first Black athlete, WWII hero deserves recognition
item.description: One of EIU’s most impactful famous alums has basically no recognition anywhere on campus. I think it’s time to change that. Charles Blakesly Hall was a student at what is now Eastern Illinois University from 1938 until he dropped to join the war effort in the spring of 1941. During the three years he was here, he was the first Black athlete at EIU where he played on the football and track teams, alongside being a pre-nursing...
